release_levels.reason: Breaking: code:merge, code:merge:<b>, setup:worktree and code:worktrees are renamed to git:merge:<branch>, git:worktree:setup and git:worktree:list with no aliases. New: git:worktree:create and git:worktree:delete. All of it goes into the one bootstrap@4.0.0 tag (R1b D16).

units.title: The git tool: git:merge per core branch and the worktree tasks
The mise tool: worktree setup and list under git:worktree
Tests
units.waits: The cases run the tasks of U1 and U2.

units.title: Review: the git tasks and the tests
init renames setup:worktree in wt.toml and worktree_install

shared_files.why: U1 and U2 falsify every passage that names the old task names

decisions.decision: Do the old names (code:merge, code:merge:<b>, setup:worktree, code:worktrees) stay as aliases?
decisions.ruling: No aliases (Recommended): R2a renames outright; the sync removes the old task files through the manifest. One bootstrap@4.0.0 tag covers R1a to R2, so no release ships between. A reversal of the design text (and the handoff) that kept the old names as aliases for one release; U5 records it.

decisions.decision: The shape of git:merge:<branch>.
decisions.ruling: One task per core branch (Recommended): the git tool ships git/merge/main and git/merge/develop, each with a when that is true only when that branch is in repo.core_branches. <branch> is always the destination. Each takes an optional source: for main, default develop when develop is a core branch, else the current branch; for develop, the current branch. The library and its landing (pr | direct-merge | direct-commit) do not change. mise's code/merge/_default goes away.

decisions.decision: How do git:worktree:create and git:worktree:delete work?
decisions.ruling: Raw git, as land.mjs (Recommended): create <branch> [--from <base>] runs git worktree add in .worktrees/<branch> of the main checkout (worktrees/ only when .worktrees/ is absent and worktrees/ exists), with -b for a new branch and base default the current branch; then mise trust and git:worktree:setup in the new worktree (D13, D14, D16, D21, D25). delete <branch> runs git worktree remove (git refuses a dirty tree; code 1), then the branch rule of D22 (git branch -D only after it proves the branch is merged into a core branch; else exit 1 and print the -D command). See D15 for the refusals.

decisions.decision: Does R2a rename the lister code:worktrees?
decisions.ruling: Rename to git:worktree:list (Recommended); the shell alias worktrees runs mise run git:worktree:list. Its content does not change.

decisions.decision: Where does git:worktree:setup live, and what else changes name?
decisions.ruling: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: setup:worktree becomes git:worktree:setup (git/worktree/setup) and stays in the mise tool, because it runs setup:mise and the setup parts; its content does not change. wt.toml pre-start runs mise run git:worktree:setup. code:git-config keeps its name.
decisions.rejected: Move it to the git tool.

decisions.decision: What does R2a require?
decisions.ruling: R1c (docs/plans/2026-11-14-task-ports), which requires R1a and R1b: R1a U4, R1b and R1c edit the same tool files and cli/. Priority 80 (10 + 70, the R1c row).

decisions.decision: Does this change plan need a review unit?
decisions.ruling: Yes, one, after the tests: the plan lands task scripts that merge, push and delete worktrees and branches.

decisions.decision: The execution mode.
decisions.ruling: teams: wave 1 holds three edit units (U1, U2 and U7).

decisions.decision: R2 is three plans; where does backlog item B28 go?
decisions.ruling: User: three plans, a→b→c (Recommended): R2a git tasks (this plan), R2b LSP, R2c plugins and setup:ai, chained by requires. B28 (install a Claude marketplace and plugins, identify LSP servers) is a piece of R2b and is finished by R2c; it is not in R2a.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 1: repo/tools/github/tools.toml and repo/tools/gitlab/tools.toml name code:merge in comments.
decisions.ruling: U1 also owns these two files, for the comments only.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 2: cli/internal/source/inventory.go and form_test.go use git.branch_pair as the when example.
decisions.ruling: Keep branch_pair in derive, and add the flags has_main and has_develop. No cli/ change.
decisions.rejected: Remove branch_pair and widen an owns to cli/.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 3: the default source can equal the destination.
decisions.ruling: No new rule: the library already refuses a source equal to the destination (merge, about line 254); the entry task passes its code on.
decisions.rejected: A new usage error in the entry task.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 4: create with an existing path, a branch only on origin, and the base folder.
decisions.ruling: .worktrees/ is relative to the main checkout, as in land.mjs. An existing path exits 1. A branch that exists only on origin is checked out as a local branch that tracks origin/<branch>; --from is then a usage error (code 2).
decisions.rejected: Relative to the current worktree; refuse a remote-only branch.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 5: git:worktree:setup fails after git worktree add.
decisions.ruling: Keep the worktree and exit 1; print the command that runs the setup again and the delete command.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 6: delete with no worktree, from inside the worktree it removes, or of a core branch.
decisions.ruling: No worktree for the branch: exit 1. Run from inside the worktree it removes: exit 2, run it from another worktree. A core branch (repo.core_branches): exit 2; it never deletes main or develop.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 7: create runs git:worktree:setup, which can use the network, but the tests must not.
decisions.ruling: create takes --no-setup, which skips the setup step. The tests and K1 use it; the docs name it.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 8: R1a U5 replaces repo/examples/repo-submodules/bootstrap.toml.
decisions.ruling: U3 edits the member's worktree_install value in the file R1a U5 leaves: repo.toml under [members.<name>].

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 9: regenerating the golden files with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 against the rule a unit never runs a generator.
decisions.ruling: A recorded exception: U3 may run the test's own UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 for cli/internal/manifest, then reviews every changed golden file; twelve golden files edited by hand are easy to get wrong.
decisions.rejected: Edit the golden files by hand.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 10: how git:merge:main reads repo.core_branches at run time.
decisions.ruling: Through ${BOOTSTRAP_BIN:-mise x -- bootstrap} config get repo.core_branches --format json, with the D85 exit-2 rule of R1a U4 when no engine is installed.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 1: .config/wt.toml is a seed file the sync never rewrites, and a member worktree_install can still run mise run setup:worktree; both break with no alias.
decisions.ruling: init rewrites mise run setup:worktree to mise run git:worktree:setup in .config/wt.toml and in each [members.<name>].worktree_install of .config/bootstrap/repo.toml, as one change labelled rename setup:worktree. check and sync report an old name there with code 2 and → Run bootstrap init. A new unit U7 owns cli/ in wave 1.
decisions.rejected: A migrate item for a hand edit; accept the breakage.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 2: the mise config of a new worktree is not trusted when setup runs.
decisions.ruling: create runs mise trust in the new worktree before git:worktree:setup, as wt.toml does.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 3: git branch -d checks merged against the HEAD of the checkout it runs in.
decisions.ruling: Merged into any core branch: delete tests git merge-base --is-ancestor <branch> <core> for each branch of repo.core_branches; if one passes, it deletes the branch with -D, which is safe after that proof; else it exits 1 and prints the -D command. This replaces the D3 text never runs -D.
decisions.rejected: Merged into the current HEAD; into the base it was cut from.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 4: the merge library runs pre-commit over hook repos from GitHub (network).
decisions.ruling: The bash cases test only the entry tasks, with a stub _scripts/merge in the scratch repo that prints its arguments (the destination and the source of each model). K2, run by the orchestrator, covers a real merge and may use the network.
decisions.rejected: Accept the network in the bash cases; a test-only knob in the library.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 5: code-merge-main refuses to run unless the current branch is develop.
decisions.ruling: Drop that rule. The library's merge_from default already lets only develop merge into main when develop exists; a repo can change it in repo.toml.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 6: create of a core branch, or of a branch another worktree has checked out.
decisions.ruling: A core branch: exit 2, as delete (D15). A branch another worktree has checked out: git refuses; create exits 1 with git's message.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 1: how create and delete read repo.core_branches.
decisions.ruling: The same way as D19: ${BOOTSTRAP_BIN:-mise x -- bootstrap} config get repo.core_branches --format json, with the D85 exit-2 rule when no engine is installed.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 2: a core branch that exists only on origin makes git merge-base --is-ancestor fail.
decisions.ruling: For each core branch, test against the local ref when it exists, else against origin/<core> when it exists, else skip that core branch.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 3: how delete finds the worktree.
decisions.ruling: It looks up the branch in git worktree list --porcelain, so it finds a worktree at any path (also one that wt or a person made), and removes that path.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 4: does --no-setup also skip mise trust?
decisions.ruling: No: --no-setup skips only git:worktree:setup; mise trust always runs (local, no network).

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 5: U5's grep check against the D20 text that must name setup:worktree.
decisions.ruling: Widen the exception: the migrate item and the D20 passages in docs/design/cli.md and docs/sync/tools/git.md may name setup:worktree.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 1: the handoff still says R2 keeps aliases for one release.
decisions.ruling: Out of scope: the handoff is a session record that the next /vwf:handoff replaces (as R1b D36, R1c D17).
decisions.rejected: Widen U5 owns to the handoff.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 2: Out of scope names this repo's own .config/, but U3 owns .config/mise/tasks/test/repo.
decisions.ruling: Out of scope names the exception: .config/mise/tasks/test/ holds bootstrap's own tests, not synced copies, so U3 owns test/repo.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 3: the tasks read the core branches through ${BOOTSTRAP_BIN:-mise x -- bootstrap}; in the tests BOOTSTRAP_BIN is unset.
decisions.ruling: The U3 cases and K1 and K2 export BOOTSTRAP_BIN=<the worktree build>.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 4: D30 lets docs/sync/tools/git.md name setup:worktree, but no edit writes a D20 passage there.
decisions.ruling: U5 adds a short D20 passage to docs/sync/tools/git.md (the doc of wt.toml): init renames the old command there.
